text:
support-alex: heads up — p99 token latency for /v1/generate spiked from ~220ms to ~1.4s starting 08:12 UTC for a subset of us-west requests. Customers reporting timeouts and retries. Noticed traces with an unexpected hop to eu-west proxy. Anyone oncall?

jordan: I see the alert, pulling traces now. which customer? any request ids?

support-alex: a few IDs in the support ticket: r:0a1b2c3d r:0f9e8d7c. Happened across multiple customers, not just one org.

maria: I grabbed a trace from r:0a1b2c3d. Trace shows routing: client -> us-west-edge -> eu-west-proxy -> us-west-internal -> inference. That eu-west hop is unexpected.

ingrid: that proxy is in our legacy peering path, should only be used during scheduled failovers. No failover in the last hour on the dashboard.

jordan: tagging @sre-bot for trace enrich. sre-bot: can you dump full path for r:0a1b2c3d?

sre-bot: Enriched trace for r:0a1b2c3d:
```
client --> us-west-edge (10.5ms) --> eu-west-proxy (980ms) --> us-west-internal (8ms) --> runtime (5ms)
```
sre-bot: eu-west-proxy added ~980ms. BGP AS path shows transit via partner-x between us-west-edge and eu-west-proxy.

maria: interesting — partner-x had a routing flap ~08:10 UTC per netops. Might have triggered a temporary detour.

support-alex: customers saw increased retries which amplified p99. Any quick mitigation? Can we pin routes or force local egress?

jordan: I can add a temporary policy to prefer direct us-west internal egress for the affected prefixes. Will push a routing override. Pushing now — will post command.

jordan: run: 
```
redwood route-override apply --scope=edge --prefix 203.0.113.0/24 --prefer=local --ttl=600
```

jordan: applied at 08:25 UTC. Monitoring.

ingrid: netops confirms partner-x is showing intermittent blackhole between 08:09–08:22 UTC. They are escalating.

support-alex: after the override p99 dropped back to ~230ms within 2 minutes. Customers reporting success.

maria: recording RCA notes: root cause — transient transit partner routing flap caused edge->egress detour through eu-west proxy. Contributing factor — our fallback policy allowed cross-region proxy as a path during edge egress failure instead of failing closed.

jordan: action items: 1) add short-term routing overrides for affected prefixes when partner flaps detected (owner: netops). 2) update fallback policy to prefer local-region-only proxy unless explicit cross-region failover is in maintenance window (owner: runtime). 3) add automated detection to alert if hop adds >200ms and is cross-region (owner: observability).

support-alex: I'll notify customers and attach trace snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: route-override v1.2 -> prod (jordan)

maria: closing thread once confirm no regression for 30m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

support-alex: thanks all — keeping this one open for 30m.
